name: Philias Ceylon
original_name: フィリアス・セイロン
source:
A bard. From the birth of the world to its future, he spins stories with his songs.

He has the power of foresight.

[Translated from [url=http://www.moonparrot.com/html/game/soukoku/chara.html]official website[/url]]
